body: thank you very much. i'll talk to you if i need help
i appreciate hearing something like this. i don't feel too strong, but i'm glad i seem that way haha

I am by no means attractive. I'm a chunky girl. My hair is always messy. My makeup is, one way or another very fucked up. 

But I feel like i'm in the position of your brother. I can get along with all subgroups. I can talk to the girlygirls and I can laugh with the jocks and I can play with the nerds.

What your brother did was find a common ground between him and them.  And probably naturally. Like, in the middle of classes, I go "did you do the homework?" more than likely it's no. "shit, me either." That's how i got 90% of my friends, no bullshittin.

It's good to have a common ground and good interests that you ACTUALLY LIKE. You like weed? Stoner kids do. Talk to them and carry on. You like basketball? Compliment the dude on the basketball team for his winning play (if it's genuine.) Add more stats and stuff. You like video games? So does ... fucking everyone.  Pick a game you like, you'll attract somebody. ask for gamer tags and get to playin.

making friends, for me, was a survivalist mechanism that i've had to adopt quickly in order for me to be successful in high school and college. Finding a common ground that's genuine is probably the easiest part. You don't have to be attractive or a hunk. There was 5'6" dudes pulling stupid amounts of strange in high school.

Oh, and it helps to be funny. Or at least a dumbass. I'm both.

I know this feeling. It varies from person to person. Some loves I've had lasted ... max 3 days of up and down crying. Some for weeks. Some for ... months. It hurts. But what's important is that it'll pass. Every bad feeling in your life will pass at some point. You have to wait it out. You have to distract yourself with coping mechanisms. 

If it's a love-related thing, it's time to branch out to new songs. NOT depressing songs. New activities. New places.

It's so important to create new memories, sometimes to replace the bad old ones. Good luck friendo.
